next_issue.title: feat(resolver): local grid expressions and arithmetic offsets in boundary coordinates
next_issue.body:
### Overview
As part of debim v0.7.0 Wave 1, allow arithmetic offsets in boundary points (e.g. `['1 - 0.60', 'B + 1.20']`) and `elevation_offset` in `IfcSlab` to eliminate auxiliary dummy grids for cantilevers, balconies, and sunken bathroom slabs.

### Tasks
1. In `src/debim/resolver.py`: Enhance 2D point resolver to parse string expressions with arithmetic (`['1 - 0.60', 'B']`) when resolving polygon boundaries.
2. In `src/debim/schema.py`: Support `elevation_offset: Optional[float] = 0.0` on `IfcSlab`.
3. Add unit tests in `tests/test_boundary_offsets.py` verifying recessed bathroom slab and cantilever balcony take-off.
next_issue.label: jules

next_issue.title: feat(roof): L-shape composite hip roof with valley/hip 3D intersection solver
next_issue.body:
### Overview
As part of debim v0.7.0 Wave 2, enable `IfcRoof` to handle non-convex L-shaped boundaries and calculate intersecting hips (สันตะเข้) and valleys (ตะเข้ราง) with multi-level eaves.

### Tasks
1. In `src/debim/roof.py`: Add polygon ridge solver for L-shaped boundary polygons.
2. Support `eaves_levels` or dual ridge heights for porch vs. main roof planes.
3. Add unit tests in `tests/test_roof_l_shape.py` verifying geometry and rafter/purlin take-off.
next_issue.label: jules

next_issue.title: feat(openings): host-wall auto-punching and multi-storey window placement
next_issue.body:
### Overview
As part of debim v0.7.0 Wave 3, support multi-storey tall windows (e.g. stairwell window W5 1.40x2.90m) and host-wall automatic cutout.

### Tasks
1. In `src/debim/schema.py`: Add `host_wall: Optional[str]` and `span_storeys: Optional[List[str]]` to `IfcWindow` / `IfcDoor`.
2. In `src/debim/resolver.py` and `compiler.py`: Generate boolean opening cutouts (`IfcOpeningElement`) in host walls.
3. Add unit tests in `tests/test_host_openings.py`.
next_issue.label: jules

next_issue.title: feat(stair): multi-flight dog-leg stair scheduling and landing elevation parameter
next_issue.body:
### Overview
As part of debim v0.7.0 Wave 4, support explicit multi-flight step distribution and landing elevations in `IfcStair: DOG_LEG`.

### Tasks
1. In `src/debim/schema.py`: Support `flight_steps: Optional[List[int]]` (e.g. `[11, 6]`) and `landing_elevation: Optional[float]` in `IfcStair`.
2. In `src/debim/qto.py`: Calculate concrete volume and formwork for multi-flight configurations.
3. Add unit tests in `tests/test_stair_multiflight.py`.
next_issue.label: jules

next_issue.title: example(thai-house): add 'บ้านร่วมสมัย ๙' 168-element model and v0.7.0 documentation
next_issue.body:
### Overview
As part of debim v0.7.0 Wave 5, integrate the official 168-element Contemporary Thai House 9 model into `examples/contemporary_thai_house/project.debim` and update docs/release notes.

### Tasks
1. Create `examples/contemporary_thai_house/project.debim` utilizing v0.7.0 features (local offsets, L-roof, host openings, ST.3 stairs).
2. Update `ROADMAP_V0.7.0.md` checklists to completed.
3. Verify with `debim validate`, `debim qto`, and `debim boq --rules cg-v480`.
next_issue.label: jules
